brief: A tool rack that hangs on a wall from keyhole hangers, with hooks for small hand tools.
costSource: token-equivalent at Muse Spark Open shared rates, info only: the Dedicated Endpoint bills GPU seconds while up (.spend/modal-dedicated.jsonl)

requirements.requirement: Hangs on wall from keyhole hangers
requirements.evidence: Three hex-acc-keyhole accessories on rear face (slot 2) at upper level: accessory:1#0,0#2, accessory:1#1,0#2, accessory:1#2,0#2 on pieces 0,0,1; 1,0,1; 2,0,1 – panel lifts onto wall screws.
3-wide × 2-high full-height hex panel (pieces 0,0,0 to 2,0,1 with snaps and jointBolts, caps on open faces) provides rigid wall rack, 487×160×414 mm.

Six hex-acc-hook plates (accessory:0#0,0#5, 0#1,0#5, 0#2,0#5, 1#0,0#5, 1#1,0#5, 1#2,0#5) on front face slot 5 across both levels; each plate provides two hooks. System-validated for cable coil, gaffer tape roll and FPV goggles; small hand tools hang from same hooks by handle/loop – demonstrated during build then cleared for clean handover.

finish.summary: 2-high × 3-wide wall panel with 3 rear keyhole hangers for wall mounting and 6 front hook plates (12 hooks total) for small hand tools. Build verified: caps and joint bolts applied, check_build OK with meshClash clear.

lines.label: M6 x 20 socket head screw, ISO 4762
M6 x 25 socket head screw, ISO 4762

notes: Tighten every M6 to 2 N.m: HAND TOOLS ONLY, never a cordless driver. These bolts clamp printed PETG, not metal: at the bolt's own 10.4 N.m rating the head crushes the plastic under it and the joint fails silently, looking tight while holding nothing. Snug, then a nudge. Re-check the bolts after the first few weeks: PETG relaxes under load and the clamp will have eased.
